message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant hubs):

| Airport | IATA Code | City / State | Notable Features |
|---------|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | ATL | Atlanta, GA | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | LAX | Los Angeles, CA | Major gateway to Asia and the Pacific; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | ORD | Chicago, IL | One of the busiest airports in the world; hub for United Airlines and American. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | DFW | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the largest airports by land area. |
| Denver International Airport | DEN | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | JFK | New York City, NY | Major hub for international flights; primary hub for JetBlue and United. |
| San Francisco International Airport | SFO | San Francisco, CA | Hub for United and a major gateway to Asia; known for its sustainability initiatives. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | SEA | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a major gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| Miami International Airport | MIA | Miami, FL | Major hub for international flights to Latin America and the Caribbean; hub for American Airlines. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | PHX | Phoenix, AZ | Hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | CLT | Charlotte, NC | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Orlando International Airport | MCO | Orlando, FL | Major hub for United and a key gateway to theme parks and tourism. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | DTW | Detroit, MI | Hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | EWR | Newark, NJ | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to the Northeast. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | IAD | Washington, D.C. | Major hub for United; serves the nation's capital. |
| Minneapolis–Saint Paul International Airport | MSP | Minneapolis–Saint Paul, MN | Hub for Delta Air Lines; known for its efficient operations. |
| Boston Logan International Airport | BOS | Boston, MA | Major hub for JetBlue and a key gateway to New England. |
| San Diego International Airport | SAN | San Diego, CA | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; known for its historic downtown location. |
| Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport | BWI | Baltimore, MD | Major hub for Southwest; serves the Baltimore–Washington metropolitan area. |
| Portland International Airport | PDX | Portland, OR | Known for its eco-friendly design and as a hub for Alaska Airlines. |

These airports are among the busiest in the country and serve as major hubs for both domestic and international travel.
